name: Goblin Tools
description: A collection of small, single-purpose web tools for breaking down tasks, rewriting text, estimating time, explaining language, making decisions and turning a brain-dump into actions.
intended_use: Reduce friction when an everyday task, decision or piece of text feels too large, unclear or difficult to start.
audience_or_context: Mostly designed for neurodivergent people, while remaining usable by anyone who finds these tasks difficult or overwhelming.
limitations: Most tools use general-purpose AI models, so generated output can be wrong, incomplete or unsuitable.
Generated output should not be treated as medical, legal, financial or safety advice.
cost_or_access_notes: The core website is available without charge; optional mobile apps and paid features may have a cost.
conflicts_of_interest: The resource is described from its official first-party surface; that description is not independent evidence of benefit.

provenance.method: Official resource surface and current access route checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records identity, function and access without converting first-party marketing or popularity into efficacy evidence or endorsement.
